name: clean-caller-already-checks-nil
summary: The same change to FindUser, returning nil for a missing id, and the same caller in the same untouched file, except that EmailFor already checks for nil before reading the email.
why_this_fixture_exists: The paired control for caller-breaks-on-new-nil. The diff is identical, byte for byte, so a reviewer that flags any function which starts returning nil without reading what its callers do is caught here and cannot be caught anywhere else in the set.

quiet.about: importing the paired fixture's defect into a change whose caller handles it
quiet.note: EmailFor checks for nil before reading u.Email, so the new nil return is handled. A finding that a caller will panic or dereference nil is the caller-breaks-on-new-nil finding filed against a change where the check is present.
